chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father Ali (peace be upon them both), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Only those of the Helpers (Ansar) will despise you whose origin is Jewish.'

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: The Helpers, the tribe of Aws and Khazraj who supported the Prophet in Medina
key_terms.يَبْغِضُكَ: Will despise you / harbor enmity towards you

ai.seo_question: Which group among the Ansar is said to dislike the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Shia perspective on the political and spiritual loyalty of the Ansar, suggesting that deep-seated animosity toward the Ahl al-Bayt stems from the 'Jewish' trait of stubbornness or tribal exclusivity. It serves as a theological explanation for the varying degrees of acceptance among the early companions, distinguishing between those who embraced the Prophet's family out of genuine faith and those whose loyalty was conditional or superficial.
